newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes up in lower trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes up in lower trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed up in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 603.22 from 600.28 on Friday.
Trade volume was 1.16 million dinars against 1.28 million dinars.
Retail stores Monoprix was up 1.31 dinar to 45.16 dinar. BDET bank was down 0.46 dinar to 14.89 dinars.
BTEI bank, chemical firm Alkimia and leasing company Placement de Tunisie, traded on the new computerised system for an experimental period, were little changed. ($=0.98 dinar)
